QUBIT GATE: RESOURCES, ORDINARY ALTERNATIVES, FAILURES AND SOURCE SCOPE
1 November 2026. All new writes are within this task. Earlier results,
including the exact thermal-port construction and its obstructions, stand.

Physical operations and full costs
==================================
The protected hardware has two identical CSS/Tanner DATA blocks, every
branch controller, every old/new mediator, and one physical flag per
DATA pair. Its Hamiltonian is static. Its nominal dissipators are local
one-qubit lowering losses. No intermediate measurements, externally
timed gates or ideal reset cycles occur during its autonomous operation.

The physical input is ideal encoded unknown DATA and all flags |0> for
storage or |1> for the one-shot gate. All other controllers/mediators
may be arbitrary and correlated with logical input, bath and reference.
The m=N/2 initialized pure flags are a paid preparation resource. They
are not reusable pure scratch. After operation they and the bath are
retained. A reservoir derivation, entropy/energy cost and noisy initial
encoding/flag factory are not supplied by the abstract one-body losses.
Finite upward flag/controller rates and calibration errors during
operation ARE admitted at the theorem's positive noise budget.

Final readout is the same IDEAL ordinary two-block DATA syndrome recovery
for storage and gate, followed by fixed decoding. It never reads flags
or controllers and contains no CNOT. Its physical noisy implementation,
time, scratch, and connectivity are unearned output resources. No ideal
native forest inverse is included in this qubit realization's readout;
small compiler frames are handled by positive comparisons in the proof.

The gate is the simultaneous CNOT on all k matched logical pairs. It is
not addressability of one chosen logical pair. The finished operation
can be held protected; a new gate, reusable sequencing, non-Clifford
logic and a universal autonomous processor are separate problems.

Explicit overhead bound
=======================
Let nu_m N bound the SOURCE three-body/degree-three memory's qubits,
including DATA. Its number of nontrivial coupling terms is at most
(3/2)nu_m N. After W, at most four terms replace each, and at most 3N
original DATA fields each contribute four monomials. Thus a loose bound
on nontrivial conditional couplings is

 m_g <= (6 nu_m+12)N.

GENERIC WHOLE-DEVICE STORAGE AND ONE LATCHED LOGICAL CNOT: SOLO CANDIDATE
1 November 2026. All earlier results are preserved.

I released exact product Gibbs balance and constructed a different
nonequilibrium code/controller regime. It covers both quantum error
sectors, all logical qubits, arbitrary initial nonflag controllers,
and a fixed positive allowance for local DATA/controller/mediator/flag/
coupler faults, including nonunital, coherent and signed calibration
errors, with the same retained finite bath and arbitrary reference.

The actual generator uses a static Pauli Hamiltonian of arity at most
THREE, at most THREE nominal couplings/neighbors per qubit, and ONE-QUBIT
nominal loss. All original DATA and flag endpoints need only pairwise
couplings. Controller-only XXX terms remain primitive. No geometric
layout, microscopic reservoir or practical scale estimate is supplied.

Two identical positive-rate, linear-distance CSS blocks and physical
flags select either storage or a ONE-SHOT matched logical CNOT layer.
For the gate, local flags relax slowly while correction runs. The same
ordinary DATA-only decoder recovers the target after a FIXED finite
latency; it need not wait for every flag to finish. The flag-number
certificate survives the damped arity/degree compiler because all its
Hamiltonian terms and proof frames commute every original flag number.
No ideal native frame or logical CNOT is placed in recovery.

For total DATA size N, full modeled output including controllers, flags
and the same bath is within

 min{2,C N(1+T)exp(-bN)}

in joint diamond norm of the intended logical map tensor ONE CPTP
auxiliary channel. Storage holds for all T>=0; the gate for T>=tau.
Positive b, local fault allowance and tau are independent of N and T.
All constants and the linear hardware multiplier can be astronomical.
Ideal encoded DATA input, initialized mode flags and ideal ordinary
DATA recovery remain explicit resources.

This is a SOLO ANALYTIC COMPOSITION CANDIDATE, conditional on the preserved
Tanner finite-controller and damped-transfer candidates. It is not an
independently audited qubit-device theorem. The asynchronous CNOT and
unfinished-density principle ALREADY HAVE a reviewed native Astra
construction; their invention is not claimed. The new work is their
finite-controller/qubit realization and full retained-auxiliary interface.
